usedFor: Enrich CRM fills in people and companies with “Enrich Person & Company”, from a domain, email or profile link.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Enrich Person & Company” in Enrich CRM
bestTemplate.why: Enrichment adds person and company details to the contact, so you know who you are replying to.

watchOut: “Enrich Person & Company” needs a domain, email or profile link, so check the incoming data carries one.
